_comment: Projects the core (JoeysRetroHandhelds/joey64-core) is built from, or that we follow for ideas. devtools/check-upstreams.py lists commits newer than 'seen' (optionally only those touching 'path'). 'seen' = the newest commit we have merged or read. After merging or reading new commits, set 'seen' to the newest one and close that source's issue.
